knownLimitations: The model only covers component families rebuilt as Foundry-native fitting registries in Phase 1.
Resolved default records that are not present in component registries remain visible but are not forced into compatibility.
Thruster and bespoke ship-specific ports are not generalized unless their component registry exposes a compatible component key and type.
No fitting calculation, power budget, heat, ammo, or shaped API behavior is implemented in this phase.
recommendedNextPhase: Build the practical fitting calculation engine on top of compatible_items_by_port.json without adding shaped APIs or UI.

rulesUsed.editability: Locked, bespoke, or explicitly uneditable ports keep default resolution but are not counted as user-editable replacements.
rulesUsed.size: Component size must be within min/max, with exactSize reported when minSize equals maxSize.
rulesUsed.subtype: Meaningful port subtype values are matched against component subtype fields.
rulesUsed.tags: Port tags are enforced only when the port exposes tag restrictions.
rulesUsed.type: SItemPortDef allowedTypes first; requiredType/portType fallback when explicit allowedTypes are absent.
rulesUsed.unknown: Ports without a supported type restriction are classified as unknown instead of allowing all components.

sourceClassification: derived from another new semantic registry
